{{Quote|Can't believe it! We just took down Salarr. Black Sun won't forget that anytime soon.|Nidaljo|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
'''Salarr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who held a leadership position in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of the gang's leaders on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Salarr allied Black Sun with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], who was undercover as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], and helped Tarnis carry out his own [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapping]] in exchange for Imperial weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in [[3643 BBY]]. However, Tarnis abandoned Salarr when the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|attacked]] Black Sun's [[Black Sun Headquarters|headquarters]], and Salarr was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Lightfight|firefight]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tarnis! We risked everything for you. Stealing those data files, faking your kidnapping&hellip; this is how you repay us?''"<br />"''You were compensated with enough weapons and armor to make Black Sun invincible.|Salarr and Tarnis|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Salarr joined the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and,<ref name="The Rescue" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], had achieved a leadership position in the organization. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]&mdash;who was posing as the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Eli Tarnis&mdash;approached Salarr with an offer to secure the criminal gang's services in exchange for advanced Imperial weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Salarr agreed to the deal, and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had Salarr hire the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Vistis Garn]] to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|steal]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] plans from a [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|military warehouse]]. When Tarnis felt that his cover was in danger of exposure, he had Salarr arrange for his own "kidnapping" by Black Sun.<ref name="The Rescue" />

Salarr's forces [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|infiltrated]] the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] and incapacitated Tarnis's guards before escorting the scientist to the nearby [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] taxi station. Salarr's lieutenant [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]] led the group to the nearby [[Coruscant Spaceport]], where they barricaded themselves in one of the [[Docking Bay 84|docking bays]] as a distraction for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. Meanwhile, Tarnis himself left his Black Sun allies at the taxi station&mdash;but instead of heading to [[Black Sun territory]] as planned, he headed to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of his other allies, the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]]. When Zeer was finally captured, he gave up Tarnis's supposed location, so CSF [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]] led a [[special tactical unit]] to rescue the doctor. Salarr's men easily repelled the CSF forces with their Imperial weaponry, driving off the [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] who attempted to set up a perimeter around the [[Black Sun Headquarters|gang's headquarters]].<ref name="The Rescue" />

However, Salarr was enraged when a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] arrived to aid the CSF [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. After deactivating the base's security systems, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] officers [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|stormed]] Salarr's headquarters from opposite directions. The furious criminal contacted Tarnis and demanded aid and explanation, and was angered when Tarnis abandoned Black Sun to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Knight and the Jedi's [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]], [[T7-O1]], reached Salarr first, and, though Salarr signaled one of his men to shoot the Jedi in the back, Nidaljo's unit arrived just in [[Time/Legends|time]] to dispatch Salarr's man before the Knight was shot. In the [[Lightfight|firefight]] that followed, Salarr and his other subordinates were killed by the Jedi and the police officers.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Black Sun doesn't surrender!|Salarr|<ref name="The Rescue" />}}
A bald man with fair skin and [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Salarr had both a large scar and a dark [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] across the right side of his face. Salarr was a hardened criminal, but he was furious when Tarnis, his apparent ally, abandoned him to the Jedi and the CSF; he also refused to surrender, even in the face of overwhelming numbers.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Equipment==
Salarr wore gray-and-red [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in combat.<ref name="The Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
Salarr first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "The Rescue" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Rescue" />
